geben = dare

sprechen = parlare

builders.guide: **Purpose:** Identify a simple object using four pictures and its name in the requested language. > > **Picture placement:** This builder’s saved arrow already points to **image slot 4, the bottom-right picture**. Always place the correct picture there. Put three different, unambiguous distractors in image slots 1–3. Do not move the arrow or randomize the correct answer’s position. > > **Slot numbering:** Count only image slots, in the order returned by the builder—not text, arrow, or icon slots. The correct picture must be the **fourth image supplied**. > > **Text:** Replace the contents of the **Text** box with the name of the object shown in image slot 4, in the requested language. Changing the card’s title is not a substitute for filling the Text box. For German beginner nouns, include the definite article, e.g. “der Hut.” > > **Translations:** No translation is required unless explicitly requested. Do not preserve sample text or inherited translations. If unexpected text appears, check the Text box’s translation fields separately from its main text. > > **Check:** Confirm that the fourth image matches the Text box and that no unwanted template text or translation remains. If a field cannot be inspected or cleared, report that limitation rather than claiming it was corrected.
builders.name: identification with 4 images

builders.guide:
Purpose: show an Italian word first. After the learner left-clicks anywhere on the card, show the German translation. Keep both boxes visible.

Italian box: always visible. Write the Italian word or short phrase. For nouns include the article, e.g. il gatto.

German box: appears on the first click. Write the German translation. For nouns include the article, e.g. die Katze.

No pictures. When adding cards, send images as [].
builders.name: Italian to German

builders.guide: Use this builder for listening to and repeating a word, then revealing its written form and Italian translation. **Preserve the existing layout, speaker icon, and reveal sequence.** - Keep the initial instruction exactly as **“Ascolta e ripeti”**. Do not translate or replace it. - The **speaker icon must be the only image**. Keep it unchanged; do not add a picture of the chosen word. **Fill the card as follows:** 1. Choose a word suitable for the learner’s level in the requested spoken language. 2. Generate audio pronouncing that word in its original language. For a German noun, include its definite article, e.g. **“das Haus”**. 3. Put the exact spoken word, including its article if used, in the **first text box**. 4. Put the **Italian translation** in the **second text box**, e.g. **“la casa”**. Do not use an example sentence or a definition. **Reveal sequence:** - **Initially:** the existing speaker icon and **“Ascolta e ripeti”**. - **First click:** the audio control. - **Second click:** the word in the spoken language. - **Third click:** its Italian translation. When adding the card, give it a name and leave replacement images empty (`images: []`) to preserve the builder’s existing speaker icon. Do not add extra text or change the builder’s design.
